For the Energy Department, Government of Punjab’s 5 MW aggregate, multi-site hospital program, our value is disciplined delivery across complex, public-sector environments combined with proven solar execution and hospital operational sensitivity.

First, we bring relevant renewable delivery at meaningful contract sizes, including completed solar deployments up to PKR 171M (completed 2024) and additional solar projects for provincial and federal government clients (completed 2024 and 2020 respectively). [CAP-032] [CAP-008] [CAP-020] This directly supports your requirement for experience on solar/renewable projects and for working with government clients in Pakistan. [CAP-008] [CAP-020]

Second, we understand “live hospital” constraints. Our portfolio includes multiple hospital IT deployments for federal and provincial government clients, evidencing our ability to plan work around 24/7 operations, access controls, and stakeholder coordination across clinical and engineering teams. [CAP-042] [CAP-018]

Third, we operate under an ISO 9001 quality management system as evidenced in our delivery record on ISO 9001-certified engagements. [CAP-030] [CAP-022]

Where the RFP sets mandatory specifics not yet evidenced in our library, we will close them through a defined compliance plan:
- Tier-1 PV modules (≥21% efficiency, 25-year linear warranty), string inverters, and mounting structures: our library does not yet evidence these exact specifications; we will meet them via OEM-authorized supply partnering and submission of datasheets/warranties with the bid.
- SCADA-based remote monitoring and a central dashboard: our library does not yet evidence SCADA delivery; we will address this via specialist integration partnering and FAT/SAT-backed commissioning documentation.
- DISCO net-metering approvals and 3-year O&M with performance guarantees: our library does not yet evidence these items; we will provide a dedicated permitting/O&M team and contractual performance KPIs in our O&M plan.

This combination—solar delivery experience, government execution maturity, and hospital-domain operational awareness—reduces schedule and coordination risk across twelve sites. [CAP-032] [CAP-008] [CAP-042]
